# Welcome in Seekers of None 
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 


### 🌐Guild Network🌐

🔸Main Guild: Masters of None🔸

🔸Banished/Cursed Guild: Exiles of None🔸

🔸Alt Guilds: Seekers of None, Adepts of None, Elites of None🔸

We use the following Guild structure for Players to progress trough and provide a suitable Guild for every Player/Combat Level:

🔸CL 1-40 ->  Seekers of None🔸

🔸CL 40-60 -> Adepts of None🔸

🔸CL 60-80 -> Elites of None🔸

🔸CL 80-100 -> Masters of None🔸

Please join the Guild appropiate for you CL.

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

### ✅Requirements✅

🔸Be Active🔸

🔸Combat Level 1-40🔸

🔸Participate in Raids🔸

🔸Contribute to Stockpile and Challenges if possible🔸

### 🚫Kick Rationale🚫

🔸5 Days Guild Inactivity🔸

🔸Rare to Low Guild Activity🔸

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

###  ⚔️Raids⚔️

➡️ EVERY DAY

🔸Crystal Caverns (Level 25) 18:00-18:38 (UTC+2)✅ACTIVE✅🔸

##### ⚔️ EVERYONE PLEASE PARTICIPATE ⚔️


══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 

###  📦Stockpile📦

Only contribute Logs and Bars. Longterm Goal is to have 10K from every Resource.

Current Material priority for the next Building Slot:

Logs:🔸Mystical Log🔸

Metal Bars:🔸Chromite Bar🔸Mystic Bar🔸

( Every other Resource is obviously fine too )

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 

### 📞Discord📞

For those interested here is a Discordlink for the Guild Server: https://discord.gg/qBBPgk8zyZ

Recommended for:

🔸Information and Resources like Tools and Calculators

🔸Raid/World Boss/Shrine alerts

🔸Take part in Decisions, shaping the future of the Guilds

🔸Ask us Questions regarding the Guilds or Game there

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
